description_en: Modifies the backup time of a backup schedule
description_zh: 该接口用于修改备份计划的备份时间
kebab_example: aliyun dbs modify-backup-strategy --backup-plan-id dbstooi01XXXX --backup-period Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBackupStrategy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup schedule
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The day of each week when the full backup task runs. Valid values:

Monday

Tuesday

Wednesday

Thursday

Friday

Saturday

Sunday
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值如下：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

BackupPeriod值必须指定每周至少两天，且日期间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: backup_period

parameters.help_en: The start time of the full backup task. Specify the time in the HH:mm format
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份开始时间，取值：格式：HH:mm。

该参数必填
parameters.name: backup_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup method that you want to use for full backups. Valid values:

simple: scheduled backup. If you specify this value for the BackupStrategyType parameter, you must also specify the BackupPeriod and BackupStartTime parameters.

Manual: manual backup.

Default value: simple
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
simple：周期备份，和BackupPeriod、BackupStartTime配合使用。
manual：手动备份。

默认为simple
parameters.name: backup_strategy_type

parameters.help_en:
The interval at which you want to perform incremental log backups. Unit: seconds.

This parameter takes effect only when physical backups are performed
parameters.help_zh:
增量时间间隔，以秒（s）为单位。
仅支持物理备份
parameters.name: backup_log_interval_seconds

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

BackupPlanId.description_en: The ID of the backup schedule

ErrMessage.example: The specified parameter %s value is not valid.

NeedPrecheck.description_en: Indicates whether a precheck is triggered. If the value of this parameter is true, you must start the backup schedule by calling the StartBackupPlan operation
NeedPrecheck.description_zh: 本次修改是否会触发预检查，如果为true则需要，再调用StartBackupPlan接口启动备份计划

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
